name: Gasthof Oberstegen
beschreibung: The Gasthof Oberstegen in Söll, Tyrol, is a traditional hotel set in the village centre. The interior is decorated in authentic Alpine style. The surrounding area features an alpine mountain landscape offering excellent hiking and skiing opportunities. The hotel features an in-house restaurant serving regional cuisine. Guest rooms are fitted with handsome wooden furnishings. A dedicated wellness area with sauna is available for relaxation. Guests benefit from the immediate proximity to the world-class SkiWelt area. On-site parking spaces are available at the property.
